stage: Exploratory negative-transfer investigation; no adopted research-question change
target: SEED-IV coarse binary valence, existing five fixed participant-disjoint 9/3/3 folds
feature_input: Exactly the retained 56-dimensional mean-window-log-bandpower trial features; named common 14 electrodes
source_data: Previously verified feature pack from joint_seediv_diagnostic; only the original DEAP/GAMEEMO training participants
normalization: Anchor every condition to one StandardScaler fitted only to that fold's SEED-IV training trials; frozen for all sources, validation, and test
model: FeatureMLP 56 -> 64 -> 32 -> 2, LayerNorm/GELU/dropout 0.2; common head, or separate binary heads for each known dataset with identical initial weights
optimizer: AdamW 0.001, weight decay 0.01, no scheduler, no AMP, gradient norm clip 1
batch_composition: Exactly equal dataset quotas and exactly equal class quotas within each dataset; replacement sampling of original trials
sampling_control: Independent pre-generated streams for each dataset/class; identical SEED-IV draw prefixes across all conditions in a fold/seed
primary_budget: 600 optimizer updates in every condition; 36,000 total trial presentations
exposure_control_budget: For pooled conditions continue to 600 times number of datasets, giving exactly 36,000 SEED-IV presentations in every condition; more total compute is explicit
validation: Every 25 updates; maximize SEED-IV validation trial balanced accuracy, ties lower balanced trial log loss; no early stopping
test: Infer only after both primary and exposure checkpoints have been selected; threshold 0.5; previously inspected development cohort
linear_control: Same anchored scaler/source subsets and four C candidates; fix total effective sample weight to SEED-IV training-trial count to control relative L2 regularization
device: CUDA, chosen by outcome-free 200-update timing check: 0.407 s CUDA versus 0.495 s CPU
novelty: Small MLPs and separate output heads are controls, not proposed novel methods. No GRU-XNet architectural superiority, label-semantics mechanism, unseen-dataset transfer, or conference readiness is established by this suite.
reporting: Report every planned condition/seed/fold and both budgets, training/validation/test behavior, source-ablation effects, head routing, paired subject uncertainty and reproduction checks; do not select a direction solely on test scores
